name: 01_Retro_Sunset

Zenith and nadir converge smoothly with no pinching; celestial objects only near middle third vertically, main feature at horizontal center. A warm gigantic striped yellow-to-peach-to-hot-pink sun just above distant dark purple angular mountain silhouettes, luminous magenta grid ground fading at the horizon, rich purple-to-coral gradient sky. Restrained atmospheric glow. Empty spacious sky, clean bold shapes. Style: clean painted stylized 1980s neon synthwave, restrained detail, consistent palette midnight #080B20 violet #19112F cyan #35E8F2 hot pink #FF4DAD. Bottom quarter is dark ground, the grid resolves into unobtrusive darkness under viewer. Avoid nearby objects, characters, text, logos, labels, frames, UI, borders, watermark. This is an original artwork inspired by the synthwave genre; not a copy of any named asset pack. Output the texture itself covering the entire image.
note: The initial generated sunset was replaced in v2 by a native geometric shader scene and baked in Unity. Other five panoramas are unchanged.
